drivers: Three sequential arithmetic steps (3% of 300, quarter of 9, times 11000) with a non-integer intermediate (2.25 sales) that may confuse some test-takers
Numbers are friendly (300, 3%, 1/4, 11000) so mental math is feasible without calculator
Distractors are near-miss multiples (×0.9, ×1.1, ×2), so partial errors land on options and partial-work elimination is limited
120 seconds is ample for the computation, so time pressure is low
